parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' path — the canonical sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The production implementation of 'DebugMetricsProvider.measureCPUUsage' resides in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel); the duplicate in DebugHUD.swift is a local debug convenience for the Wallpaper sample app. Consolidating these would couple the DebugPanel production package to sample-app demonstration semantics, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against. No refactor is warranted unless the sample-app copy is confirmed to be a removable leftover rather than a deliberate fixture.
